# Requirements Quality Checklist: Optional Image Recolour Workflow

**Purpose**: Validate that colour restoration, ordering, resume, overwrite, GUI, and downstream handoff requirements are clear enough for implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are enablement and default-behaviour requirements defined for both disabled and enabled colour restoration modes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001-FR-006]
- [x] CHK002 Are raw-image preservation and corrected-output separation requirements documented without leaving ownership of raw inputs ambiguous? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007-FR-009]
- [x] CHK003 Are downstream handoff requirements complete for raw SfM/COLMAP undistortion, colour-restored splatting image inputs, and standard LFS paths? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010-FR-012]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for splatting wait/block behaviour while colour restoration is incomplete, active, applying, failed, or skipped? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013-FR-014, FR-043]
- [x] CHK005 Are GUI requirements complete for preview display, parameter controls, navigation, keyframe list details, close choices, and progress feedback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022-FR-028, FR-042]
- [x] CHK006 Are standalone and reopened colour restoration command requirements specified for both incomplete and completed runs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029-FR-032]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the shared image ordering strategy described with clear precedence between capture metadata and natural relative-path ordering? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015-FR-018]
- [x] CHK008 Are default keyframe selection rules clear enough to distinguish centred bin placement from starting at image zero? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, SC-002]
- [x] CHK009 Are all Wildflow colour parameters, neutral defaults, and operation meanings explicitly named and numerically specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-046-FR-048]
- [x] CHK010 Are interpolation rules clear for independent numeric parameters, before-first images, after-last images, one edited keyframe, and no edited keyframes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-049-FR-052]
- [x] CHK011 Is overwrite behaviour stated as an explicit user confirmation after warning that the current corrected version will be overwritten? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, FR-035]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Are requirements consistent that SfM and COLMAP undistortion always use raw images while only splatting-stage image inputs may use corrected images? [Consistency, Spec §US2, FR-007-FR-012]
- [x] CHK013 Are resume and active-session state requirements consistent across GUI reopening, standalone colour restoration, splatting wait behaviour, and reruns? [Consistency, Spec §US6-US7, FR-029-FR-035]
- [x] CHK014 Are global and per-camera correction requirements consistent with multi-camera folder preservation and raw reconstruction identity? [Consistency, Spec §US2, US8, FR-021]
- [x] CHK015 Are skip/cancel/continue choices consistently defined in user stories, functional requirements, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §US3, US7, US9, FR-042-FR-043, SC-020]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Are success criteria measurable for ordering, keyframe placement, state restoration, corrected image mirroring, and splat wait behaviour? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002-SC-008]
- [x] CHK017 Are GUI usability success criteria stated with an objective boundary such as minimum supported window size and non-overlapping controls? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK018 Are corrected-output criteria measurable for exact count, relative paths, filenames, dimensions, RGB output, extension preservation, and JPEG quality? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005, SC-012]
- [x] CHK019 Are standalone and reopened workflow outcomes objectively measurable through documented commands and restored state? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-015-SC-018]

## Scenario And Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are primary, alternate, exception, and recovery flows represented across disabled runs, enabled runs, GUI interruptions, standalone use, and reopened sessions? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [x] CHK021 Are edge cases documented for timestamp problems, too few images, unedited keyframes, one edited keyframe, partial apply failure, and source/output mismatch? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Are multi-camera edge cases documented for global mode, per-camera mode, mode switching, and preserving camera folder identity? [Coverage, Spec §US8]
- [x] CHK023 Are final-output safety requirements defined to prevent preview or thumbnail data from becoming saved corrected dataset images? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-054]

## Dependencies And Assumptions

- [x] CHK024 Are assumptions documented for local workstation use, graphical desktop availability, run output state, timestamp reliability, and sibling corrected image roots? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK025 Are documentation requirements defined for background SfM behaviour, reviewing corrected outputs, reopening the GUI, standalone colour restoration, and splatting wait behaviour? [Dependency, Spec §FR-044, SC-018]
